skill.summary: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, artifacts, posters, or applications (examples include websites, landing pages, dashboards, React components, HTML/CSS layouts, or when styling/beautifying any web UI). Generates creative, polished code and UI design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the frontend-design skill, version 0.1.0.
- Provides detailed guidelines for creating production-grade frontend interfaces with bold, memorable aesthetics.
- Emphasizes distinctive visual direction, creative implementation, and avoidance of generic "AI slop" design traits.
- Offers best practices for typography, color, motion, layout, and visual detail to ensure refined, non-generic user interfaces.
